notes: "HUANDENG builds on OpenSlide. OpenPPTD contributes formula-conversion modules and PptxGenJS supplies PPTX generation. The PPTD approach was inspired by the Kimi Slides ecosystem; that is not a claim about inventing a universal standard. Charts, formulas and functional icons also build on open-source work. The public DNA example comes from PDB 1BNA and Drew and colleagues. Sources and licenses stay with the project; third-party marks do not imply endorsement.\n\nSources and scope: sources/brand/manifest.json; notices/; sources/science/source.json; https://recent.design/ . The GitHub mark identifies the OpenPPTD repository, not an OpenPPTD product logo."
